title: Lab - Configure user resource limits and user privileges
description: Cap what users may consume and what they may run as root.
scenario: Cap what users may consume and what they may run as root. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Limits
tasks.instructions: Limit group devops to 50 processes (hard) and open files to 1024 (soft).

tasks.title: Task 2 - sudo
tasks.instructions: Let ana run systemctl restart sshd with sudo and nothing else, without a password.
tasks.solution: visudo  # ana ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl restart sshd

tasks.title: Task 3 - Audit
tasks.instructions: Find every sudo invocation in the logs today.
